title: Hom identification counit normalization
statement: For every dualizing datum, rational Verdier datum, and HomIdentification h, the counit of h.adjunction at every K,M equals normalizedCounit for h.permitted at K,M.

proof.text: Use h.integral_evaluation on integral representatives and the fact that raw rational objects are unchanged integral representatives under localization. The normalized braiding and closed evaluation are the canonical rationalization of the integral evaluation field.

lean.statement:
theorem homIdentification_counit_normalized
    (w : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (A : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl X E w)
    (h : HomIdentification l E X D hl w A) :
    ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (h.adjunction K).counit.app M = normalizedCounit D l hl X E h.permitted K M
